decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct sources claiming membership for Turkish-German University. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S10, D1S12, D1S14) explicitly states membership in the 'Anatolian University Libraries Consortium Association' (also referred to as 'ANKOS'). Document 2 (D2S9, D2S12) explicitly states membership in the 'Community College Consortium for Open Educational Resources' (also referred to as 'CCC-OER'). The prompt instructions require preserving all supported alternate referents and treating all source segments as fallible data where distinct valid answers may coexist. Since both documents provide direct textual evidence for different memberships, all four variations (full name and acronym for each) are retained as valid answers.
